title: Candidate
description: One place that may need to change, carrying every observation made about it. FROZEN (ARCHITECTURE.md 5). A candidate is never deleted; it gets a status (law L1). 'status' is required at schema level so an unexplained candidate cannot be persisted.

id.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the identity tuple {provider, claim_type, claim_key}, not of the whole record. Attaching further evidence must never change the identity, or the candidate would disappear and a new one appear.

provider.description: Name of the ProviderPack whose SurfaceSpec produced this candidate.

evidence_ids.description: Every observation attached to this candidate, sorted. Append-only: deduplication attaches, it never discards provenance.

status.description: The explanation. There is no 'unexplained' member: a candidate without a status is unrepresentable.

reason.description: Why this status, in terms a reviewer can check against the attached evidence.

close_with.description: The precise action that would resolve this candidate. Required to be non-empty for UNKNOWN and HUMAN_REQUIRED (ARCHITECTURE.md 4: every UNKNOWN prints a close-with instruction).
